title: Shader CSS
blurb: Add fx="ripple" to any element to run it through a fragment shader. CSS custom properties are the uniforms, so transitions animate it.
question: Can an HTML attribute draw an element through a fragment shader, with CSS custom properties as the uniforms?

blankFrames.why: known: one shader tile is blank for a single frame while its surface starts

glContexts.why: known: each fx element has its own WebGL context when WebGPU is not used (7 here). One shared context, as fx-backend="shared" does, would remove this.
